contexts.text: Bethlehem = the Spiritual of the Celestial in a new state.
Under Benjamin, see these references. AC 4592:3. AE 449:2.

This is Bethlehem () = the resurrection of a new Spiritual Celestial. Bethlehem = the Spiritual of the Celestial in a new state, for Ephrath = the Spiritual of the Celestial in the former state. AC 6247.
The reason the Lord was born at Bethlehem... was that He alone was born a spiritual celestial man...
David was born and also anointed king there; hence Bethlehem was called the city of David.
As Bethlehem = truth conjoined with good in the natural man, David was born there, and was also anointed king there...

The Lord was born in Bethlehem because He was born a King, and with Him from birth truth was conjoined with good... With the Lord alone was the Natural eager for good and filled with longing for truth...
Ephrata = the Word as to its natural sense, and Bethlehem = the Word as to its spiritual sense, and the Lord willed to be born there because He is the Word.
